_README: Philippines-specific personal job tracker. LinkedIn/Indeed/Google Jobs are available in existing workflows. JobStreet source uses JobSpy SEEK adapter only when explicitly authorized and enabled by repository variable ENABLE_JOBSTREET_SCRAPER=true. Other PH boards are linked as search shortcuts. All results must link to individual job posts.

keywords._comment: A job TITLE is kept if it contains any of these. Use full words; multi-word phrases match as substrings.
keywords._exclude_comment: Exclude clearly senior jobs; relax as needed for mid-level roles.
keywords._fuzzy_comment: Optional fuzzy pre-filter for LinkedIn title matching. When both fuzzy_seniority and fuzzy_domain are non-empty, role_is_relevant() uses these instead of the exact-phrase keywords.include filter. Catches title variants like 'Director, Engineering' when searching for 'Engineering Director'. Leave all three empty to use keyword-only matching.

search_terms._comment: Queries sent to the job boards' search boxes. Broader than 'keywords' (which then filters the titles).

locations._comment: LinkedIn needs a geoId (find via the guest endpoint; leave blank to let LinkedIn resolve the text). JobSpy-backed boards such as Indeed, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter, and Google Jobs need a location + country (USA, Australia, Canada, GB...). locations.hiring_cafe is retained for compatibility, but the legacy HiringCafe route is currently blocked upstream by a Cloudflare challenge. The map auto-fits to wherever the jobs are.
locations._linkedin_partitions_comment: Optional. Used by --linkedin-emit-matrix / --linkedin-backfill-partition for parallel backfill. Each state gets one matrix worker per search term. High-volume states can be day-sliced to work around LinkedIn's ~1000 result/query cap. Leave empty to use single-run backfill (--linkedin-backfill).

location_filter._comment: Case-insensitive substrings matched against a job's location text. Used to post-filter boards that don't support geo-scoping at the API level: the curated direct-ATS sweep, and NEOGOV/GovernmentJobs.com (a nationwide board). Keep this in sync with your locations.* entries above.

google_jobs._comment: Optional exact Google Jobs queries. Leave empty to auto-build queries such as '<term> jobs near <location> since yesterday' from search_terms.google_jobs and locations.google_jobs. If the free JobSpy path is blocked, set SERPAPI_API_KEY or OXYLABS_USERNAME/OXYLABS_PASSWORD as GitHub Actions secrets for an API fallback.

jobspy._comment: Optional. Prefer JOBSPY_PROXIES as a GitHub Actions secret/env var for private proxy credentials. Use only if JobSpy-backed boards are blocked.

hiring_cafe._comment: Legacy setting retained for compatibility. As of 2026-10-22, HiringCafe redirects /jobs/<query> to hiringcafe.com and returns a Cloudflare 403 challenge to this non-browser client. max_pages cannot fix the block; see README before enabling or replacing this source.

employers._priority_comment: Optional. Companies worth a daily 'priority' digest even on a quiet day (case-insensitive substring match on the company name). Leave [] to disable.
employers._exclude_comment: Optional. Drop roles from these companies even if the title matches (case-insensitive substring). Used here to remove pharma/drug-development.

priority_topics._comment: Optional. Roles touching these get a gold ★ + a 'Priority topics' filter on the dashboard. [name, regex] pairs.

role_categories._comment: Dashboard 'Role' filter buckets, applied top-to-bottom to each title. [name, regex] pairs.

notify._comment: Pushover phone alerts (optional; needs PUSHOVER_TOKEN/USER secrets). Notify when a new role is a priority-topic OR scores at/above min_fit.

weekly_digest._comment: Optional weekly Pushover brief. Prefer enabling via the WEEKLY_DIGEST_PUSHOVER repository variable so forks stay quiet by default.

marketing_digest._comment: Operational settings for the optional marketing digest workflow. Searches use this config's restored terms and locations.
